SELECT i0."Id", i0."CaseId", i0."CreatedAt", i0."Notes", i0."OwnerId", i0."Reasoning", i0."Score", i0."Status", i0."SupportingEvidence", i0."Suspect", i0."UpdatedAt", i0."Version", d."InvestigationId", d."EvidenceId", d."ExaminedAt", l."Id", l."InvestigationId", l."Kind", l."Rationale", l."RevisedAt", l."SourceId", l."TargetId"
FROM (
    SELECT i."Id", i."CaseId", i."CreatedAt", i."Notes", i."OwnerId", i."Reasoning", i."Score", i."Status", i."SupportingEvidence", i."Suspect", i."UpdatedAt", i."Version"
    FROM "Investigations" AS i
    WHERE i."Id" = @id AND i."OwnerId" = @_8__locals1_c_OwnerId
    LIMIT 2
) AS i0
LEFT JOIN "Discoveries" AS d ON i0."Id" = d."InvestigationId"
LEFT JOIN "Links" AS l ON i0."Id" = l."InvestigationId"
ORDER BY i0."Id", d."InvestigationId", d."EvidenceId"

SELECT i0."Id", i0."CaseId", i0."CreatedAt", i0."Notes", i0."OwnerId", i0."Reasoning", i0."Score", i0."Status", i0."SupportingEvidence", i0."Suspect", i0."UpdatedAt", i0."Version", d."InvestigationId", d."EvidenceId", d."ExaminedAt", l."Id", l."InvestigationId", l."Kind", l."Rationale", l."RevisedAt", l."SourceId", l."TargetId"
FROM (
    SELECT i."Id", i."CaseId", i."CreatedAt", i."Notes", i."OwnerId", i."Reasoning", i."Score", i."Status", i."SupportingEvidence", i."Suspect", i."UpdatedAt", i."Version"
    FROM "Investigations" AS i
    WHERE i."Id" = @id AND i."OwnerId" = @_8__locals1_c_OwnerId
    LIMIT 2
) AS i0
LEFT JOIN "Discoveries" AS d ON i0."Id" = d."InvestigationId"
LEFT JOIN "Links" AS l ON i0."Id" = l."InvestigationId"
ORDER BY i0."Id", d."InvestigationId", d."EvidenceId"

SELECT r."Id", r."CreatedAt", r."Fingerprint", r."Key", r."OwnerId", r."Response"
FROM "Receipts" AS r
WHERE r."OwnerId" = @_8__locals1_c_OwnerId AND r."Key" = @_8__locals1_c_Key
LIMIT 2

SELECT r."Id", r."CreatedAt", r."Fingerprint", r."Key", r."OwnerId", r."Response"
